title: Flutter package with no Flutter SDK constraint
description: pubspec.yaml declares an `environment` block that names no Flutter version. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `environment` block that names no Flutter version.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix an `environment` block that names no Flutter version.
limitation: It matches an `environment` block that names no Flutter version in the parsed pubspec.yaml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
